title: ISO 17640:2018 — Non-destructive testing of welds — Ultrasonic testing
locator: Manual ultrasonic testing of fusion-welded joints in metallic materials, primarily full-penetration ferritic welds, thickness ≥8 mm, low ultrasonic attenuation and object temperatures 0 °C to 60 °C; ISO/DIS 17640 is under development to replace it.
notes: 不得套用于薄板、复杂几何、高衰减或材料条件不符的焊缝；方法适用性及修订状态需核验。
